sources.title: Government of the Republic of China (Taiwan)

capital.evidence_quote: Taipei City is the seat of the central government and the economic hub of Taiwan

sources.title: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan)

currency.evidence_quote: The New Taiwan Dollar (TWD, NT$) is the legal tender currency of Taiwan

timezone.evidence_quote: National standard time in Taiwan is UTC+8 without daylight saving adjustments

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential single-phase electric supply in Taiwan is 110V 60 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: The alternating frequency of the electrical grid across Taiwan is 60 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Wall outlets in Taiwan accommodate US-style Type A and Type B plugs with two flat parallel pins

police.evidence_quote: Dial 110 for emergency police response throughout Taiwan

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 119 for emergency medical services and ambulance dispatch

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 119 for fire and disaster rescue operations

general.evidence_quote: 112 serves as the international unified mobile emergency redirect number

tourist_police.evidence_quote: 24-hour toll-free tourist hotline for international visitors is 0800-011-765

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Tayvan dünyanın en güvenli ve misafirperver seyahat ülkelerinden biridir; standart önlemler yeterlidir.
advisory_headline.en: Taiwan is one of the safest and most welcoming destinations globally; exercise normal precautions.
advisory_headline.de: Taiwan ist eines der sichersten und gastfreundlichsten Reiseländer weltweit; normale Vorsichtsmaßnahmen genügen.
advisory_headline.ru: Тайвань — одна из самых безопасных и дружелюбных стран мира; действуют обычные меры предосторожности.
advisory_headline.es: Taiwán es uno de los destinos más seguros y hospitalarios del mundo; aplican precauciones normales.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Taiwan reach 98.4 Mbps with comprehensive 5G coverage

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in Taiwan measure 175.2 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Chunghwa Telecom, Taiwan Mobile, and FarEasTone offer unlimited data prepaid SIMs/eSIMs at Taoyuan (TPE) and Kaohsiung (KHH) airports. Passport and second ID required for in-person registration.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Telecom operators require passport verification for prepaid telecommunication services

religion.value: Buddhism, Taoism, and traditional folk religion with over 15,000 active temples
religion.evidence_quote: Taiwan enjoys vibrant religious pluralism with syncretic Buddhist and Taoist practices

festivals.value: Pingxi Sky Lantern Festival, Dragon Boat Festival, Mid-Autumn Festival, Mazu Pilgrimage
festivals.evidence_quote: Iconic cultural highlights include the Pingxi Lantern Festival and nationwide Dajia Mazu pilgrimage

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Eating, drinking, or chewing gum inside MRT stations beyond the yellow line is strictly prohibited and subject to fines of NT$1,500 to NT$7,500. Bringing pork products from abroad carries severe agricultural fines up to NT$1,000,000.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Drinking and eating are strictly forbidden in paid areas of the Taipei Metro under the Mass Rapid Transit Act

tipping.value: Tipping is not customary in Taiwan. Upscale restaurants add a 10% service charge to the bill; tipping taxi drivers or street vendors is neither expected nor practiced.
tipping.evidence_quote: Tipping is not part of Taiwanese culture; 10% service charge is included in full-service dining
